mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decrease does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.
